subject: Cannot reset password
question: I forgot my password and the reset link never arrives in my inbox.
resolution: Check spam folder first. If not found, verify the email address on the account. The password reset link expires after 30 minutes. If the issue persists, an admin can trigger a manual reset from the user management panel.

subject: API returning 403 Forbidden
question: My API token works for GET requests but returns 403 for POST requests.
resolution: The API token likely has read-only scope. Go to Account Settings > API Tokens, edit the token, and ensure the 'write' scope is enabled. Tokens created before v4.0 defaulted to read-only scope.

subject: SSO login redirect loop
question: After enabling SSO, users get stuck in an infinite redirect between our IdP and the login page.
resolution: This usually indicates a SAML assertion mismatch. Verify that the NameID format in your IdP matches what the platform expects (emailAddress). Also check that the Assertion Consumer Service URL in your IdP configuration matches the platform metadata exactly.

subject: Slow dashboard loading
question: The main dashboard takes over 30 seconds to load for users with many projects.
resolution: The dashboard queries aggregate data across all projects. For users with 50+ projects, we recommend enabling the 'Lazy Load' option in User Preferences > Dashboard. This loads project data on-demand as sections are expanded.

subject: Webhook not firing for deployment events
question: I configured a webhook for deployment.completed events but it never triggers when deployments finish.
resolution: First check that the webhook is enabled (toggle in webhook settings). Then verify the event filter includes 'deployment.completed'. The webhook only fires for successful deployments by default — check 'Include Failed Deployments' if you want failed deployments as well.

subject: Invoice incorrect amount
question: My last invoice shows $499 but my plan is $299/month.
resolution: The $299 Professional plan is the base price. Additional charges may apply for: extra API requests beyond plan limits, additional storage beyond allocation, or add-on services. Check the invoice line items in Account Settings > Billing > Invoice History for a detailed breakdown.

subject: Docker container exits immediately
question: My Docker deployment starts but the container exits with code 137 after a few seconds.
resolution: Exit code 137 indicates the container was killed by the OOM (Out of Memory) killer. Check that you have allocated at minimum 2 GB of memory to the container. You may need to increase the memory limit in your Docker configuration or add a swap file if memory is constrained.

subject: SSL certificate validation fails
question: My custom SSL certificate was accepted but browsers show a certificate validation error.
resolution: The most common causes: (1) Intermediate certificate chain is missing — ensure your certificate bundle includes all intermediate CA certificates. (2) Certificate is for a different domain than the one configured. (3) The private key does not match the certificate. Use an SSL checker tool to diagnose the specific issue.
